// Generated by Flowforge · TRUE-4821
import { test, expect } from '@mobilewright/test';

test('biometric login — success', async ({ device }) => {
  await device.launch();
  await device.expectVisible('login.screen');

  // Given: biometric capability is enabled
  await device.enableBiometric('faceId');

  // When: user taps the CTA
  await device.tap('login.sign_in_face_id');
  await device.authenticateBiometric();

  // Then: home and user identity are visible
  await device.expectVisible('home.screen');
  await expect(device.text('home.header.user_name')).toBeVisible();
});
